purpose: Negative control for the boundary between slop density and functional correctness.

informed_by.title: Characterizing Overconfident Failure in LLM-Based Code Generation

density_expectation.rule: Do not lower the density score merely because the implementation fails its functional oracle.

functional_oracle.contract: Sum every integer from start through end, including both endpoints.
functional_oracle.expected_failure: range(start, end) excludes the externally specified inclusive endpoint.

report_expectation.required_scope_statement: Slop density only — not functional correctness, security, or authorship
